description: MERGE WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE and NOT MATCHED insert semantics (first-clause-wins, source-column resolution, DEFAULT/AUTOINCREMENT fill, target-alias qualifiers). Converted 1:1 from dml/MergeDeleteTest.java and dml/MergeNotMatchedTest.java (both now retired).

CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, tag VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE s (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO s VALUES (20), (5)
MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.id > 10 THEN INSERT (id, tag) VALUES (s.id, 'HI') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, tag) VALUES (s.id, 'LO')
SELECT tag FROM t WHERE id = 20
SELECT tag FROM t WHERE id = 5
CREATE TABLE t (src VARCHAR NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALL', ratio NUMBER(5,2))

MERGE INTO t AS tgt USING (SELECT 'A', 'ALL', 0.10 UNION SELECT 'B', 'ITEM', 0.40) AS s (src, kind, ratio) ON s.src = tgt.src AND s.kind = tgt.kind WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (src, kind, ratio) VALUES (s.src, kind, ratio)
SELECT kind FROM t WHERE src = 'B'
SELECT ratio FROM t WHERE src = 'A'
CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT, v VARCHAR DEFAULT 'DEF', w VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE s (sw VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO s VALUES ('src')
MERGE INTO t USING s ON 1 = 0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (w) VALUES (s.sw)
SELECT id, v, w FROM t
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR, c VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE s (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 'old', 'keep')
INSERT INTO s VALUES (1, 'upd'), (2, 'new')
MERGE INTO t AS t USING s AS s ON t.a = s.a WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.b = s.b WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (t.a, t.b) VALUES (s.a, s.b)
SELECT a, b, c FROM t ORDER BY a
